Lower Text: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to this Digimon.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [CS] trait Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost. This effect can't play cards with the same name as any of your Tamers.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects place [CS] trait Digimon cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon may digivolve into a [CS] trait Digimon card in the hand without paying the cost.
